name: Woodland Scouts

items.name: Troop Movement
items.text: Whenever a troop moves, you move one of its segments and the other segments follow behind it. At the end of the movement, you can group the other segments adjacent to the one you moved as you see fit, provided none of them moves farther than the moving segment. If you choose not to move the troop any distance, you can instead reshape the position of all the segments as long as one stays in place.

items.name: Among the Trees
items.text:
Requirements Every square the woodland scouts occupy is in forest terrain

---
Effect The woodland scouts disperse among the trees. They Take Cover and then use that cover to hide, attempting a Stealth check.

items.name: Forest Passage
items.text: Woodland scouts ignore any difficult terrain caused by plants and fungi, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth.

items.name: Longbow Barrage
items.text: The scouts draw or reload their longbows, then send forth a flurry of arrows. This barrage is a 10-foot burst within 100 feet that deals 3d8 piercing damage with a DC 24 basic Reflex save save. If the scouts are Hidden or undetected, this deals an additional 2d6 precision damage. When the troop is reduced to 2 or fewer segments, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst.

items.name: Stealthy Formation
items.text: If the scouts become Hidden or Undetected, they remain so until they take a hostile action.

items.name: Thicket of Blades
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The scouts engage in a coordinated melee attack against each enemy in a 5-foot emanation, with a DC 24 basic Reflex save save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8+3 slashing damage

2 2d8+6 slashing damage

3 3d8+9 slashing damage

text:
Elves of the forest or jungle take advantage of the terrain, operating in units that seemingly appear from the trees themselves.

---
Elves' long lives give them centuries to delve into studies, artistry, or exploration.
